name: CodeRabbit

plugin.name: code-review
includes: 4 parallel review agents (CLAUDE.md compliance ×2, bug scan, git-history analysis)
Confidence scoring with an 80 threshold to filter false positives
Posts the PR comment through the gh CLI

whatYouLose: Runs on every PR automatically (the plugin runs when you call it, or from your own CI)
Built-in linter/SAST aggregation and multi-repo analysis
notes: Covers the core PR-review loop for teams already using Claude Code. You trade the always-on bot for a command you run or script.
